title: Billing (Stripe)
summary: Stripe subscription billing with checkout, webhooks, and customer portal for the @saas template.

envVars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Stripe secret key for server-side API calls. Obtain from Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API Keys.

envVars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for validating webhook payloads.

envVars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
envVars.description: Stripe publishable key for client-side Stripe.js initialization.

envVars.name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PRO_MONTHLY
envVars.description: Stripe Price ID for the Pro plan (monthly). Create in Stripe Dashboard > Products.

postInstall.description: Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, and STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PRO_MONTHLY to .env.local.
Generate Drizzle migrations for the subscriptions and stripe_customers tables.

Configure a Stripe webhook endpoint in the Stripe Dashboard pointing to /api/webhooks/stripe with events: customer.subscription.created, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, checkout.session.completed.
Read /docs/modules/billing for the full integration guide and Stripe test card numbers.
